title: Global analysis of the Kuramoto flow
summary: Kuramoto's differential equation describes a synchronization process between several harmonic oscillators. It has been used to model biological phenomena such as the synchronization of heart cells, the circadian rhythm, or brain waves. It is also used in power system control. The simplest possible model assumes that all oscillators are identical and connected to each other with equal pairwise attraction.
